claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gated_persistent_debuff
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Slow applies an area save gate that, on failure, imposes a bundle of ongoing debuffs persisting for the concentration duration, with a per-creature repeat_save at end of each affected creature's turn to individually end the effect. No existing family models: (1) initial save gate combined with persistent multi-effect state, (2) multi-operation debuff bundles on a single attachment, or (3) per-creature end-condition via repeat saves. The activation family has no persistence; the ongoing_effect family has no initial save gate and supports only one operation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect — debuff effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Effect is currently DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Slow's on-fail effects are a bundle of debuffs (modify_speed, modify_ac, modify_roll_numeric on Dex saves, restrict_action_set / deny reactions). All these atoms exist in v4 but are not reachable from Effect. Widening Effect to include them is necessary before any conditional persistent debuff spell can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: An affected target's Speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take Reactions.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActionRestriction — one_of_action_or_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Slow restricts affected creatures to take either an action or a bonus action per turn, not both. The existing ActionRestriction.exclude can block specific StandardActionKind members but cannot model the 'choose at most one of {action, bonus_action}' resource pool pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: somatic_failure_chance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Slow imposes a 25% probability that any spell with a Somatic component cast by an affected creature fails outright. This is probabilistic spell interference triggered by the debuff state. No v4 atom models a probability-gated failure injected into another creature's cast procedure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a 25% chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell's gestures too slowly.
